ipBan.title: Address bans
ipBan.help: An address that fails to sign in too often is banned for a while. If you connect over Tailscale or IPv6, whitelist your network.
ipBan.toggle: Ban addresses after repeated failed sign-ins
ipBan.off: Address bans turned off. Running bans no longer apply.
ipBan.invalid: Failed sign-ins: {{minFailures}} to {{maxFailures}}. Window: {{min}} to {{maxWindow}} minutes. Length and longest ban: {{min}} to {{maxDuration}} minutes.
ipBan.cli: From the host, even while Meshloom runs: meshloom-admin list-bans, meshloom-admin unban ADDRESS, meshloom-admin whitelist add NETWORK.

errors.auth_ip_banned: Too many failed sign-ins: your address is blocked for a while. Try again later.
errors.auth_ban_whitelist_invalid: Not an IP address or network.
errors.auth_ban_whitelist_exists: This network is already in the whitelist.
errors.auth_ban_whitelist_not_found: This network is not in the whitelist.
